tasks.title: Journal ownership before effects
tasks.dependency_mode: P01; P25 Q for executable controls
tasks.changes: Implement a durable outside-workspace reservation/ownership journal in **new** `tools/native-test-owner/journal/`: register intent before effect, record owner/start/path identities, leases, operation ID and argument digest, partial acquisitions, monotonic state.
tasks.acceptance: Crash between reservation and marker remains discoverable; conflicting replay is rejected; wrong PID/path is not authority.
tasks.evidence: Save fault-point journal fixtures; commit journal.

tasks.title: Implement grants and idempotent dispatch
tasks.dependency_mode: P07; P25 Q for executable controls
tasks.changes: Implement run/case grants, typed handles, at-most-once operation dispatch and bounded framed request/reply/event channels in `tools/native-test-owner/protocol/` and `.../service/`.
tasks.acceptance: Same ID/same arguments joins; changed arguments reject; lost acknowledgment reports indeterminate without redispatch. Subject stdout cannot forge a supervisor message.
tasks.evidence: Save frame/dispatch controls; commit service core.

tasks.title: Own bounded workspaces
tasks.dependency_mode: P07; P25 Q for executable controls
tasks.changes: Implement owned scratch creation, identity-safe file operations, seal/lease and disposal in `tools/native-test-owner/workspace/`.
tasks.acceptance: Partial allocation, symlink replacement, foreign/active lease, exceeded byte/entry/depth and failed deletion remain charged/unresolved.
tasks.evidence: Save bounded filesystem controls; commit workspace owner.

tasks.title: Own processes and descriptors
tasks.dependency_mode: P08; P25 Q for executable controls
tasks.changes: Implement process tree and descriptor authority in `tools/native-test-owner/process/`: exact executable/environment/fd map, spawn-start identity, separate offered/accepted/EOF/writer-exit/child-exit facts, signal/wait/reap and descendant edges.
tasks.acceptance: F1 fd 3 non-reader, delayed EOF, malformed frame, orphan/detached-child and PID reuse controls cannot produce clean release; fd 4 lease remains distinct.

tasks.title: Drain, recover and receipt owned resources
tasks.changes: Implement stop-admission, bounded drain, owner-only cleanup, recovery scan and compact completion receipt in `tools/native-test-owner/recovery/` and `.../receipt/`.

tasks.title: Reserve host capacity and deadlines
tasks.changes: Implement one host-wide live-run admission gate and atomic declared-peak reservation (one live case, one offline verification worker, one build producer) in `tools/native-test-owner/admission/`; charge cleanup reserve and enforce absolute monotonic deadlines.
tasks.acceptance: Two repository roots cannot bypass the gate; nested producer demand does not deadlock; deadline-at-success is failure; no case starts if body plus cleanup cannot fit.
tasks.evidence: Save bounded race controls; commit admission.

tasks.title: Qualify strict host enforcement
tasks.changes: Qualify the host's strict process/memory/temporary-data mechanism, charged scope and finite overshoot bound, including detached children and writes outside workspace helpers. Owner: `tools/native-test-owner/host/` plus host-profile acceptance record.
tasks.acceptance: Quick envelope (64 processes, 4 GiB, 512 MiB) and bounded-job envelope (64, 6 GiB, 2 GiB) are admitted only where enforcing mechanisms and disposal reserve are demonstrated. Poll-and-kill or sample peaks cannot qualify them; unavailable host remains blocked.
tasks.evidence: Save host-specific negative controls; commit profile acceptance separately.
